'''Orlut''' was a [[Lyrobru]] [[cyborg]] employed by the [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]] as part of his [[Corporate Sector]] [[Dunn's crew|crew]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. She was arrested along with other members of the crew and placed in a cell on the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' in [[132 BBY]].

The crew was able to [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escape]] from the [[starship]] in the [[Carlac belt]] by exploiting a flaw in the [[prison ship]]'s [[Variable geometry droid|droid crew]] and ejecting in an [[escape pod]]. Orlut and the rest of the prisoners were then recaptured and detained in a holding cell in a holding cell in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Orlut was a [[Lyrobru]] [[cyborg]] who was a part of the [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]]'s [[Dunn's crew|crew]] of lowlifes in the [[Corporate Sector]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. She was kept in the slicer's employ due to [[Standard Galactic Grid|credits]] she owed the slicer for software upgrades and ended up arrested alongside him and other members of the crew. Due for processing by the [[Detention Task Force]], she was placed on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]''<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> in a cell with Dunn and several other members of the crew<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> in [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref>

The cell next to Orlut and Dunn's was occupied by the [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya]], who it was rumored had [[Death|killed]] a [[Jedi]]. As such a feat was unheard of among the other [[prisoner]]s, they were impressed and Dunn so attempted to recruit her into a plan to [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escape]] the [[prison ship]]. Once she refused, Dunn commenced the plan anyway, which began with the<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Hybroid]] [[Rott Mercer]] exploiting a flaw in the [[starship]]'s [[droid]] crew<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> that deactivated the [[variable geometry droid]] [[pilot]]s and caused the ship to exit [[hyperspace]]<ref name="Lost Found" /> in the [[Carlac belt]]. The prisoner [[Shorwilt]] [[Tor Bez'lin]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> then destroyed the [[Unidentified droid warden|warden droid]] and opened the crews' cell using the droid's [[Limb|arm]]. Leaving Aniseya and the incapacitated prisoner<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Melo Tolicus]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Orlut and the others then packed into an [[escape pod]] and ejected from the ship.<ref name="Lost Found" />

Orlut and the other escapees weres soon recaptured and placed behind a [[force field]] in a holding cell on the detainment level of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. When the [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] passed by the cell, Dunn and Bez'lin yelled out that the that the entire [[prison]] break had been Aniseya's idea and that their group had not done anything. Sol continued on to the adjacent cell where Tolicus was being held and learned the truth of Aniseya's involvement from him during interrogation.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Personality and traits==
Orlut had [[Color|grey]] skin and black [[eye]]s enhanced with [[Cybernetics|cyborged]] optic nerve fortification that allowed her much better vision then her eyes would naturally allow.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While imprisoned, Orlut wore brown [[Clothing|robers]], with darker brown pants, black [[boot]]s and a brown [[hat]]. She also wore a brown [[Belt|sash]] with pockets concealed inside where she kept [[Lockpick set|lockpicking tools]] prior to her arrest. A hidden [[dagger]] sheath on her right ankle was also emptied during her imprisonment.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orlut appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The prison ship and Jedi Temple scenes were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in a preview for the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
